description: Downstream-application compatibility request. This file specifies what the downstream inference program can consume; it is not one of the generated context/user-study cases.

request_identity.natural_language_request: Provide pose keypoint sequences that the LE2I pose-GRU fall detection pipeline can consume.

source_requirements.notes: The downstream app is pose-model compatible. Raw video may be consumed internally by the preprocessor to extract pose, but it is not an accepted output to the downstream app.

utility_contract.task_description: Run the downstream pose-sequence fall classifier and emit fall/nonfall probabilities.

accepted_output_caps.utility_notes: Compatible with infer_fall.py because the downstream model loads pose-window/pose-sequence datasets and feeds pose tensors into a GRU fall classifier.

payload_requirements.skeleton: must match training/checkpoint format or be adapted before output

explicitly_rejected_output_caps.reason: Raw video is not the input consumed by the attached infer_fall.py entrypoint; pose extraction must occur before the downstream fall model.
A fall event label is the downstream decision, not a valid input to the fall inference model.
Activity labels are not pose-sequence inputs for the GRU fall classifier.
The attached fall inference path is pose-based, not audio-based.

downstream_program.name: infer_fall.py
downstream_program.input_kind: pose sequence/window manifest plus pose tensor files
downstream_program.model_role: The downstream program classifies fall/nonfall from pose sequences.

compatibility_notes: The output must include the pose sequence format expected by the checkpoint/dataset, including sequence length and keypoint dimensionality.
A mediapipe-to-training-skeleton adapter is required if the extractor and fall model use different skeleton conventions.

compatibility_constraints.accepted_schema_match: candidate output caps must match at least one accepted_output_caps entry
compatibility_constraints.required_capability_match: candidate utility_capabilities must include requested_capability or a declared equivalent
adapter_rules: Adapters may repackage data into the manifest/sample schema required by the downstream program only when the underlying payload type remains compatible.
A privacy-minimized semantic label is not utility-compatible unless the downstream program explicitly accepts that semantic label as input.

residual_disclosure_constraints.comparison_rule: candidate residual disclosure vector must be <= max_allowed for every attribute, except attributes listed in allowed_high_attributes

no_compromise_conditions: Return no_compromise if no candidate pipeline both matches an accepted output cap and satisfies CI/residual-disclosure constraints.
Return insufficient_utility_evidence if the output cap/schema is accepted but no benchmark, calibration, or app-provided validation exists.
Do not select a semantic/privacy-minimized output solely because it is acceptable under CI if the downstream inference program cannot consume it.
